	local function f542(p254)
		local version = p254.version
		if version == up0 then
			local t123 = { success = true, message = "" }
			return t123
		end
		if version == nil then
			local t124 = {
				success = false,
				message = string.format(
					"state version is missing; expected version %s; apply migrations first",
					tostring(up0)
				)
			}
			return t124
		end
		if type(version) ~= "number" then
			local t125 = {
				success = false,
				message = string.format(
					"state version has invalid type \"%s\"; expected number %s",
					tostring(type(version)),
					tostring(up0)
				)
			}
			return t125
		end
		if up0 < version then
			local t126 = {
				success = false,
				message = string.format(
					"state version %s is newer than supported version %s",
					tostring(version),
					tostring(up0)
				)
			}
			return t126
		end
		local t127 = {
			success = false,
			message = string.format(
				"state version %s is older than supported version %s; apply migrations first",
				tostring(version),
				tostring(up0)
			)
		}
		return t127
	end

local function f588()
	local function f589()
		if up0 == nil then
			return
		end
		local v1 = up0.autosave
		if type(v1) == "string" then
			up1:Set(true, true)
			up2:Set(up3(v1), true)
		else
			up1:Set(false, true)
			up2:Set(nil, true)
		end
		local autoload = up0.autoload
		if type(autoload) == "string" then
			up4:Set(true, true)
			up5:Set(up3(autoload), true)
		else
			up4:Set(false, true)
			up5:Set(nil, true)
		end
		if not v1 then
			v1 = autoload
		end
		if type(v1) == "string" then
			up6:Set(up3(v1), true)
		end
	end

		up0()
		up1()
	end

	local function f598()
		local Value6 = up0.Value
		if up1 == nil or type(Value6) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		up1:DeleteFile(Value6)
		if up2 ~= nil then
			if type(up2.autosave) == "string" and up3(up2.autosave) == Value6 then
				up2.autosave = nil
				up4:Set(false, true)
			end
			if type(up2.autoload) == "string" and up3(up2.autoload) == Value6 then
				up2.autoload = nil
				up5:Set(false, true)
			end
			if up6.Value == Value6 then
				up6:Set(nil, true)
			end
			if up7.Value == Value6 then
				up7:Set(nil, true)
			end
			up8:SaveState()
		end
		up9()
	end

	local function f1499(p252, p253)
		if p252.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			return
		end
		if p252.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			if up0._visible then
				up0:Hide()
				local _activeBar = up0._activeBar
				if _activeBar ~= nil then
					_activeBar.Collapse()
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if p252.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
			local IsKeyDown = up1:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
			if not IsKeyDown then
				IsKeyDown = up1:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
			end
			if IsKeyDown and up2.Visible then
				local _activeBar2 = up0._activeBar
				if _activeBar2 ~= nil then
					_activeBar2.Expand()
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if not up0._visible then
			return
		end
		if p252.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			up0:_moveSelection(1)
		elseif p252.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then

	local function new_raycast_params(p176)
		local CurrentCamera8 = up0.CurrentCamera
		if CurrentCamera8 == nil then
			return
		end
		local Lightning = up1.data.Weather.Lightning
		local Height = Lightning.Height
		local Position10 = CurrentCamera8.CFrame.Position
		local v170 = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local Distance = Lightning.Distance
		local v171 = math.min(up2.LIGHTNING_RADIUS_MIN, Distance)
		local v172 = v171 + math.random() * (Distance - v171)
		local v173 = Position10.X + math.cos(v170) * v172
		local v174 = Position10.Z + math.sin(v170) * v172
		local v175 = RaycastParams.new()
		v175.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local localPlayer = up3.LocalPlayer
		if localPlayer then
			localPlayer = up3.LocalPlayer.Character
		end
		if localPlayer then
			v175.FilterDescendantsInstances = table.create(1)
		end
		local v177 = Position10.Y - up2.LIGHTNING_GROUND_DROP
		local Raycast4 = up0:Raycast(
			Vector3.new(v173, Position10.Y + Height, v174),
			Vector3.new(0, -up2.LIGHTNING_RAY_LENGTH, 0),
			v175
		)
		if Raycast4 then
			v177 = Raycast4.Position.Y
		end
		local v178 = Vector3.new(v173, v177, v174)
		local v179 = Vector3.new(
			v173 + (math.random() - 0.5) * up2.LIGHTNING_JITTER,
			v177 + Height,
			v174 + (math.random() - 0.5) * up2.LIGHTNING_JITTER
		)
		local _lightning = p176._lightning
		local Strike = _lightning.Strike
		local t75 = {
			color = Lightning.Color,
			thickness = Lightning.Thickness,
			maxRadius = Lightning.Jaggedness,
			branches = Lightning.Branches,
			flashBrightness = Lightning.Flash
		}
		local t76 = {
			enabled = Lightning.Sparks.Enabled,
			color = Lightning.Sparks.Color,
			count = Lightning.Sparks.Count,
			thickness = Lightning.Sparks.Thickness,
			distance = Lightning.Sparks.Distance,
			speed = Lightning.Sparks.Speed,
			jaggedness = Lightning.Sparks.Jaggedness
		}
		t75.sparks = t76
		local t77 = {
			enabled = Lightning.Explosion.Enabled,
			size = Lightning.Explosion.Size,
			bolts = Lightning.Explosion.Bolts,
			color = Lightning.Explosion.Color
		}
		t75.explosion = t77
		Strike(_lightning, v179, v178, t75)
		if Lightning.Sound.Enabled then
			local v180 = up4(Lightning.Sound.SoundId)
			if v180 ~= nil then
				p176:_PlayThunder(
					math.sqrt((v173 - Position10.X) ^ 2 + (v174 - Position10.Z) ^ 2),
					Lightning.Sound.Volume,
					Lightning.Sound.Delay,
					v180
				)
			end
		end
	end

	end

		function t217:_FireStrike()

			end

			local Height2 = Lightning2.Height

			local v401 = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
			local Distance2 = Lightning2.Distance
			local v402 = math.min(v378.LIGHTNING_RADIUS_MIN, Distance2)
			local v403 = v402 + math.random() * (Distance2 - v402)
			local v404 = Position22.X + math.cos(v401) * v403
			local v405 = Position22.Z + math.sin(v401) * v403

			end

			end
			local v408 = Position22.Y - v378.LIGHTNING_GROUND_DROP
			local Raycast6 = workspace2:Raycast(
				Vector3.new(v404, Position22.Y + Height2, v405),
				Vector3.new(0, -v378.LIGHTNING_RAY_LENGTH, 0),
				v406
			)
			if Raycast6 then
				v408 = Raycast6.Position.Y

	local function color_from_hsv3()

		local v339 = up0.b7()

		local function f5739(p265)

		local function f5740(p266, p267)

				local K = Color3.fromHSV(T.Hue, T.Sat, T.Val)

		function t154.getRank(p305)
			return v285[p305]
		end

		function t154.buildMetadata(p306, p307)
			local t155 = v285[p306]
			if t155 == nil then
				return nil
			end
			if t155.name == "Unranked" then
				local t156 = { SeasonELO = nil, SeasonLeaderboardRank = p307 }
				return t156
			end
			if t155.requiresLeaderboard and p307 == nil then
				p307 = 1
			end
			local t157 = { SeasonELO = t155.requiredELO, SeasonLeaderboardRank = p307 }
			return t157
		end

		return (table.freeze(t154))
	end

	local function f6531(p308, p309)
		local v293
		if p308.score == p309.score then
			v293 = p308.hit.Label < p309.hit.Label
			return v293
		end
		local v294
		v294 = p308.score < p309.score

	local function get_focused_textbox()

			return (function(T)

					return Vector3.zero
				end
				local T = Vector3.zero
				local z = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
				if c.KeyboardEnabled then
					local h = z.LookVector
					local K = Vector3.new(h.X, 0, h.Z)
					if K.Magnitude > 0 then
						K = K.Unit
					end
					if c:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
						T = T + K
					end
					if c:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
						T = T - z.RightVector
					end
					if c:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
						T = T - K
					end
					if c:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
						T = T + z.RightVector
					end
					if c:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
						T = T + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
					end
					if c:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or c:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
						T = T - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
					end
				else
					local c = U:GetControls():GetMoveVector()
					if c.Magnitude > 0 then
						T = T + z.LookVector * -c.Z
						T = T + z.RightVector * c.X
					end
				end
				return T
			end
		end)({[0]=c0,[1]=c1})
		end)(userInputService, PlayerModule3)

	local function new_random()
		local pi6 = 3.141592653589793
		local v436 = Random.new()
		local v437 = pi6 * 2

		local function f7015(p323, p324, p325)
			local NextNumber5 = v436:NextNumber(0, v437)
			local NextNumber6 = v436:NextNumber(p324, p325)
			return CFrame.new(p323 + Vector3.new(
				math.cos(NextNumber5) * NextNumber6,
				0,
				math.sin(NextNumber5) * NextNumber6
			)) * CFrame.fromOrientation(
				v436:NextNumber(0, v437),
				v436:NextNumber(0, v437),
				v436:NextNumber(0, v437)
			)
		end

		return f7015
	end

	end

			return

		function t192:Open()
			if self._fadeState.tweening then
				return
			end
			local ActivePage4 = self._tab.ActivePage
			if ActivePage4 == self or
				not (ActivePage4 == nil or not ActivePage4._fadeState.tweening) then
				return
			end
			self._menu:CloseOverlays(nil, true)
			if ActivePage4 ~= nil then
				ActivePage4:_setSelected(false)
				self._menu:FadeCanvasGroup(ActivePage4._page, false, ActivePage4._fadeState)
				if ActivePage4._pendingOpen then
					ActivePage4._pendingOpen = false
				else
					ActivePage4.Opened:Fire(false)
				end
			end
			self:_setSelected(true)
			self._menu:FadeCanvasGroup(self._page, true, self._fadeState)
			self._tab.ActivePage = self
			if self._tab._openedOnce then
				self._openedOnce = true
				self:_maybeRealize()
				self.Opened:Fire(true)
			else
				self._pendingOpen = true
			end
		end

		function t192:_flushPendingOpen()
			if not self._pendingOpen then
				return
			end
			self._pendingOpen = false
			self._openedOnce = true
			self:_maybeRealize()
			self.Opened:Fire(true)
		end

		function t192:_maybeRealize()
			local _grid7 = self._grid
			if _grid7 == nil then
				return
			end
			if self._tab.ActivePage ~= self then
				return
			end
			if not self._tab._openedOnce then
				return
			end
			_grid7:Realize()
		end

	local function new_random()
		local t198 = {}
		local v389 = up0.y()
		local v390 = up0.ii()
		local v391 = Random.new()
		local v392 = 1073741824

		function t198.compute(p235)
			local Random3 = v389.data.Ragebot.Evasion.Random
			local BaseRadius2 = Random3.BaseRadius
			local v393 = BaseRadius2 * Random3.RadiusRandomFactor
			local Position33 = p235.Position
			local v394 = Random3.AnchorFromCharacter
			v394 = v394 and Position33 or Vector3.new(0, Position33.Y, 0)
			local t199 = v390(v394, BaseRadius2, BaseRadius2 + v393)
			local NextInteger4 = v391:NextInteger(1, 3)
			local Position34 = t199.Position
			local v395 = Position34.X
			local v396 = Position34.Y
			local v397 = Position34.Z
			if NextInteger4 == 1 then
				v395 = v392
			elseif NextInteger4 == 2 then
				v396 = v392
			else
				v397 = v392
			end
			return t199 - Position34 + Vector3.new(v395, v396, v397)
		end

		return t198
	end

	local function f8878(p1, p2, p3)
		local t2, v1
		v1, t2 = up0(up1.decodePayload, p3)
		if not v1 then
			local _errorReporter5 = p1._errorReporter
			local Report3 = _errorReporter5.Report
			local err54 = up2.err
			string.format("failed to decode peer payload: %s", tostring(t2))
			Report3(_errorReporter5, err54().error)
			return
		end
		if t2.shouldRemovePeer then
			p1._items:ClearRemotePlayerOverrides(p2)
			return
		end
		local overrides = t2.overrides
		if overrides ~= nil then
			p1._items:SetRemotePlayerOverrides(p2, overrides, t2.shouldMerge)
		end
	end

	local function f8879()
		local v2 = up0.y()
		up0.cV()
		up0.ac()
		up0.dy()
		local v3 = up0.b()
		local v4 = up0.q()
		local v5 = up0.dS()
		up0.dW()
		local t3 = {}
		t3.__index = t3

		function t3.new(p4, p5, p6, p7)
			local v6 = v4.new("cosmetics.Bridge")
			local t4 = {
				_trove = v6,
				_userServer = p4,
				_errorReporter = p5,
				_items = p6,
				_emotesResolver = p7,
				_isSendQueued = false,
				_shareActive = false,
				_lastSentPayload = nil
			}
			local v7 = setmetatable(t4, t3)

			local function f8880(p8, p9)
				v7:_HandlePeerPayload(p8, p9)
			end

			v6:Connect(p4.peerPayloadReceived, f8880)

			local function f8881(p10)
				p6:ClearRemotePlayerOverrides(p10)
			end

			v6:Connect(p4.peerRemoved, f8881)

			local function f8882()
				v7._lastSentPayload = nil
				v7:NotifyStoresUpdated()
			end

			v6:Connect(p4.showActivated, f8882)

			local function f8883(p11)
				v7:SetShareActive(p11)
			end

			v6:Connect(v2:GetPropertyChangedSignal((table.create(2))), f8883)
			if v2.data.UserServer.ShareSkins then
				v7:SetShareActive(true)
			end
			return v7
		end

		function t3:_HandlePeerPayload(p12, p13)
			local t5, v8
			v8, t5 = up0(v5.decodePayload, p13)
			if not v8 then
				local _errorReporter6 = self._errorReporter
				local Report4 = _errorReporter6.Report
				local err55 = v3.err
				string.format("failed to decode peer payload: %s", tostring(t5))
				Report4(_errorReporter6, err55().error)
				return
			end
			if t5.shouldRemovePeer then
				self._items:ClearRemotePlayerOverrides(p12)
				return
			end
			local overrides2 = t5.overrides
			if overrides2 ~= nil then
				self._items:SetRemotePlayerOverrides(p12, overrides2, t5.shouldMerge)
			end
		end

		function t3:SetShareActive(p14)
			if self._shareActive == p14 then
				return
			end
			self._shareActive = p14
			if p14 then
				self:_TrySendCurrentInventory()
			end
		end

		function t3.IsShareActive(p15)
			return p15._shareActive
		end

		local v9 = 0.5

		function t3:NotifyStoresUpdated()
			local _userServer3 = self._userServer
			if not (self._shareActive and _userServer3:IsShowActive() and _userServer3:IsConnected()) then
				return
			end
			if self._isSendQueued then
				return
			end
			self._isSendQueued = true

			local function f8884()
				self._isSendQueued = false
				if self._shareActive and self._userServer:IsShowActive() and
					self._userServer:IsConnected() then
					self:_SendIfChanged()
				end
			end

			task.delay(v9, f8884)
		end

		function t3:_TrySendCurrentInventory()
			local _userServer4 = self._userServer
			if self._shareActive and _userServer4:IsShowActive() and _userServer4:IsConnected() then

	local function espModule(p171)
		local ESP = up0.data.ESP
		local t183

		local Settings3 = ESP.Settings
		local Get55 = up1:Get(Settings3.Font)
		local Get56 = up1:Get(Settings3.FlagFont)
		local FontSize = Settings3.FontSize

		local Spacing2 = Settings3.Spacing
		local _sideFrames = p171._sideFrames

		end
		local _boundingBox = p171._boundingBox

		local v253 = BoxImage.Enabled
		if v253 then
			v253 = not (BoxImage.Path == "")
		end
		if Box.Enabled or v253 then
			if Box.Enabled then
				_boundingBox:SetStyle(Box.Style)
				_boundingBox:ToggleOutline(true)
				_boundingBox:SetInnerLook(Box.Color, up3.resolve(Box.Animation))
				local FilledBox = t183.FilledBox
				if FilledBox.Enabled then
					local Gradient3 = FilledBox.Gradient
					if Gradient3.Enabled then
						local SetFillLook = _boundingBox.SetFillLook
						local Color12 = Gradient3.Color
						local Transparency7 = FilledBox.Transparency
						local v254 = Gradient3.Animate
						if v254 then
							v254 = true
						end
						v254 = v254 and "Swirl" or nil
						SetFillLook(_boundingBox, Color12, Transparency7, v254)
					else
						_boundingBox:SetFillLook(
							FilledBox.Color,
							FilledBox.Transparency,
							nil
						)
					end
					_boundingBox:ToggleFill(true)
				else
					_boundingBox:ToggleFill(false)
				end
			else
				_boundingBox:ToggleOutline(false)
				_boundingBox:ToggleFill(false)
			end
			if v253 then

				_boundingBox:SetImageLook(BoxImage.Transparency)
